units.source_text: 在这张饭桌前坐下来后，夫人对我解释说，因为那天店家没有按时送鱼来，所以不得不上街给我们买菜去了。

en.t: After I sat down at that dining table, the lady explained to me that, because the fishmonger had not come on time that day, she had had to go into town to buy food for us.

units.source_text: 我一想，说的也是，既然有房客要照应，这也在情理之中。

en.t: When I thought about it, that was true; since she had a lodger to look after, it was only reasonable.

units.source_text: 这时小姐又瞅着我笑了起来，但是夫人一呵斥，小姐马上就收住了笑。

en.t: At that moment the young lady looked at me and started laughing again, but when the lady scolded her, she immediately stopped.
